instruction: Sit still and write normally (seat calibration)
Take the phone out and use it in your hand
Put the phone away and write normally
BRIEF glance: phone in hand for ~2 s only (should NOT alert)
Place the phone on the desk next to the paper and keep writing
Put the phone away and write normally
Use the phone in your hand - move it around and partly cover it with your hand
Put the phone away and write normally
Lean far to the side as if looking at a neighbour's desk
Stretch your arms quickly for ~2 s (should NOT alert)
Slide the chair sideways (~50 cm) and stay there
Move back to your seat and write normally
Fidget - turn around / look behind repeatedly
Use the phone low near the desk edge (partly hidden)
